audit.why: 8.5/10 difficulty against a 49.21% win rate over 1203 games is consistent: the lane is hard to play but close to even in outcome because levels 6 and first item swing back to you.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows said Ziggs while the packet chart and the matchup's own prose said otherwise, including Level 6 — rated 2/10 on a row the text calls 'your clearest solo-kill window'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is [Ziggs, Skill, Skill, Skill, Renekton, Renekton, Ziggs]. whys[1] says 'dead-even'; whys[2] calls level 3 your first realistic kill window; whys[4] calls level 6 your clearest solo-kill window; whys[5] tells you to force the all-in at first item. The page was rendering Ziggs-favoured on all four.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 and 2 to Skill, rows 4 and 5 to Renekton, with ratings corrected off 2/10 and phases[4].why restated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Satchel Charge is the tracked ability everywhere but its cooldown is never stated, and the knock-away is described as if it only affects you.
audit.why: Satchel Charge is 20/18/16/14/12s at 1000 range, and Riot's text is explicit that Ziggs is knocked away too — that is why it doubles as his escape. Hexplosive Minefield is a flat 16s slow field at 900 range, and Bouncing Bomb is 6s at rank 1 from 850 range. Those three numbers are the entire engage decision.
audit.corrected: State the 20s Satchel cooldown and the 16s minefield as the two gaps to engage in.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown number appeared in the punishable-window advice.
audit.why: Satchel Charge at 20s rank 1 is the most punishable cooldown in the lane; his Q is only 6s so trying to dodge poke is not the plan.

edits.before: Dominus stats turn even fights into wins before 25 minutes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Ziggs's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Dominus HP absorbs his burst and Fury refills fast — you can eat one Satchel knockback and still finish the solo kill.

edits.before: His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Satchel Charge knocks you back and him too — 20s at rank 1, so engage inside that gap.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1 — bait it before you slice in.

edits.before: Track Ziggs's Satchel Charge: His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. When it is down — Fury W-stun + dash out.
edits.after: Satchel Charge (20s) knocks you both away and Hexplosive Minefield (16s) slows your approach — engage when either is spent.

notes: The packet's suspectName 'Stack Hexplosive Minefield' is a FALSE POSITIVE — the name is correct, the flag caught the leading verb. FLAG MISFIRE not written to the page: Ziggs's W carries a 'percentHealth' flag and the _missing rule says Satchel Charge bypasses resistances, but Riot's own description says only 'deals magic damage to enemies, knocking them away' with no max-health component, so I left that claim out entirely — see unverified. Chart edits are one atomic group of four matched pairs; the rating flips ride with them because a 2/10 on Level 6 directly contradicted the row's own why text.
